info.title: Małopolska Social Innovation Hub — Matchmaking API
info.description: AI-assisted matchmaking between a described social problem and existing social innovations, documented cases and contextual evidence. Relevance means suitability for the described need, not a probability of success.

tags.name: Tester
tags.description: Innovation tests, tester applications, ratings and feedback.

tags.name: Problem reports
tags.description: Grassroots problem reporting: residents, NGOs and institutions signal local problems; the public list shows the review status and the administrator response.

tags.name: Assistant
tags.description: Conversational assistant that clarifies a resident need and recommends municipal programs. State is stored per conversation; searches are stable and paginated without re-running the LLM.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administrator-only dashboard statistics and innovation submission review. Every endpoint requires a Bearer token belonging to an administrator.

post.summary: Interpret a problem and return ranked innovations
post.description: Interprets the problem, retrieves catalogue candidates and returns up to five grounded recommendations. Returns `needs_clarification` with up to three questions when material information is missing, `no_match` when nothing fits, and `degraded` when part of the AI pipeline is unavailable.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of catalogue innovations for the knowledge library. Filter by free text (`q`), problem tag, target group, evidence status and synthesis flag.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over title, summary, description and tags.

parameters.name: synthetic
parameters.description: When set, only synthetic (true) or verified (false) records are returned.

get.summary: Get innovation details and source references
List innovation tests open to testers
Get test details, application count and remaining slots

post.summary: Declare willingness to take part in a test
post.description: Registers the caller (Bearer token) or the shared demo user when no token is provided. One application per test and user.

409.description: Recruitment closed or application already exists.

get.summary: List my test applications with their feedback

post.summary: Submit or update test feedback, rating and improvement suggestions

get.summary: Aggregated tester ratings and improvement suggestions for an innovation
List reported social problems with their review status

post.summary: Report a local social problem (residents, NGOs, institutions)

get.summary: Get a single problem report and its review status

get.description: Aggregated counters for users, catalogue innovations, innovation submissions, problem reports, tests, tester applications and matchmaking, plus 14-day activity, category breakdown and recent items. `pending` submissions are those not yet accepted.

Paginated innovation submissions with the author. Filter by free text (`q`, matched against title, description and author e-mail), acceptance flag and workflow status. `counts` are computed over all submissions and are not affected by the filters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search over title, description and author e-mail.

200.description: Paginated submission list with global counts.

patch.summary: Accept or reject an innovation submission
patch.description: Updates only `isAccepted` and/or `status`; at least one field is required. The expected review actions are `{ "isAccepted": true, "status": "approved" }` and `{ "isAccepted": false, "status": "rejected" }`.

post.summary: Record usefulness feedback for a recommendation
Send a message and receive the next assistant step
post.description: Send free text (omit `conversationId` to start a new conversation) or answer a clarification question. Depending on the updated conversation state the response is `clarification`, `recommendations` (a first page of a stable search) or `message`.

200.description: Clarification, recommendations or a plain assistant message.

400.description: Validation error or a stale clarification answer.

get.summary: Read a page of a stored search ranking
get.description: Returns a slice of the stable ranking saved for a search. Does not call the LLM, generate an embedding or run vector search again.

200.description: A page of recommendations with pagination metadata.

EligibilityStatus.description: `conflict` means an explicit mismatch (never returned to the client as a recommendation).

conversationId.description: Omit on the first message to start a new conversation.

isAccepted.description: Administrator decision flag. `true` accepts the submission.

counts.description: Global counters over all submissions, independent of the filters.

categories.description: Top problem report categories; missing category counts as `Inne`.

activityByDay.description: Last 14 days, inclusive, chronological; missing days are filled with zeros.

recentActivity.description: Merged submissions, problem reports, tester applications and tests, newest first.
